overview_description.description:
Cedar is a patient payment and engagement platform for hospitals, health systems, and medical groups that elevate the end-to-end patient experience. The platform leverages advanced data science to customize and simplify the payment experience, resulting in a modern, consumer-friendly way for patients to plan for and pay their bills.

It was founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York, United States.

about_short_description.short_description: Cedar is a patient payment and engagement platform for hospitals, health systems, and medical groups that elevates the patient experience.

product.name: Cedar Pay
product.description: A patient payment solution for pre-visit and post-visit billing, communications, payment processing, and financing options.

product.name: Cedar Cover
product.description: A coverage and financial assistance solution that supports Medicaid and ACA enrollment, coverage maintenance, and denials resolution.

product.name: Cedar Support
product.description: A patient financial support solution that automates service interactions, billing assistance, outbound communications, and early-out workflows.

product.name: Kora AI
product.description: An AI-powered voice agent for healthcare call centers that handles patient financial support interactions by phone.

product.name: Cedar Intelligence
product.description: A healthcare financial intelligence capability that uses patient payment data and learning models to personalize engagement and optimize financial workflows.

product.name: Implementation
product.description: Implementation, integration, and security services for deploying Cedar’s patient financial experience solutions within provider environments.
